title: Daily model feature snapshot (NOT raw refinery transaction)
description: One example derived feature row per (business_date, unit_code, product_code). Source facts must live in normalized feeds/production/events/energy tables. Every feature used for forecasting is point-in-time computed; this schema is a learning/ETL exchange contract, not a direct operator input form.

as_of.description: Knowledge cut-off for predictors; target production may be learned later only as training label, never serving feature.

crude_feed_lag1_t.description: Feed known prior to as_of, not same-day unknown future feed

product_production_t.description: Approved actual TRAINING LABEL for this date, only after actual is available. Never served as an input to forecast this same date.

source_lineage_id.description: Identifier linking curated row to approved source facts
